Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.


For more information please see our contact details.

    Beginners & Improvers Badminton Course — Now Open

    badmintonbeginnersimproverscoachingfitnessmeathnavansports

    Ever wanted to give badminton a go? Now’s your chance! We’re excited to announce our 10-week Badminton Course for Beginners & Improvers.

    Whether you’re brand new or looking to sharpen your skills, this is a fun, friendly way to learn the basics, build confidence, and get active — no experience needed. Just bring yourself and a willingness to learn!

    📅 Course Details

    • Starts: Wednesday 18th February
    • Duration: 10 weeks (every Wednesday)
    • Location: St Paul’s National School, Navan
    • Who it’s for: Complete beginners + improvers

    Our coaches will guide you through everything from how to hold a racket to landing your first smash. Expect great coaching, a welcoming atmosphere, and plenty of fun on court.

    ✅ Check out the poster for full details — see you on court soon!

    Unbeaten Start to 2026: 2 Wins & 3 Draws in a Big Week

    badmintonmatch-resultsladiesmensmixedcupleaguenavanmeath

    Unbeaten start to 2026 ✅ 5 matches, some cracking results, and we’re still unbeaten!

    This week’s results

    • Wednesday: Grade 3 Ladies ‘A’ beat Skryne 3–1 at home Grade 7 Ladies smashed Julianstown 4–0 away

    • Thursday: Grade 2 Mixed derby: our ‘A’ vs ‘B’ finished 2–2 Grade 6 Mens drew with Oldcastle

    • Friday: Grade 4 Mixed ‘A’ dug out a hard-earned 2–2 away to Ardee ‘B’

    2 wins + 3 draws — can’t complain with that!

    Next week… is bonkers

    We’ve got at least 12 matches coming up: 9 League games and 3 Cup matches. It all kicks off tomorrow (Sunday) with Grade 7 Mixed away to Skryne ‘C’ in the Cup, then it’s games all week Monday–Friday.

    Get down and support the teams if you can — big week ahead!

    Incredible Weekend at the Leinster CAC Graded Individuals!

    Leinster-CACMixed-DoublesLadies-DoublesCompetitionWinners

    🎉 Incredible Weekend at the Leinster CAC Graded Individuals! 🎉

    Our players were out in force over the weekend, and they absolutely delivered! We couldn't be prouder of how our players performed. The standard was high, the competition was tough, but our team really stood up and showed what they're made of.

    Leinster CAC Graded Individuals 2026 (3rd/4th January):

    🏆 Grade 1 Mixed Doubles Winners

    • Aaron Chen and Anneke De Jong

    🏆 Grade 2 Ladies Doubles Winners

    • Miriam Keogan and Catherine Kealy

    🥈 Grade 2 Mixed Doubles Runners-up

    • Miriam Keogan and Gerard Morgan

    A massive shoutout to Miriam Keogan for bringing home two medals from the weekend. That takes some doing! 🥳

    It's always great to see our members representing the club so well. Thanks to everyone who travelled to support and to all the other members who took part. The atmosphere was brilliant, and days like this are what it's all about. 💪

    #LeinsterCAC #ProudClub #TeamSpirit
